text: キャタピー　なんか　じゃ　ダメか

structure.jp: キャタピー　なんか　じゃ

patterns.name: 〜なんか
patterns.explanation: なんか means 'something like', often a little down on it. キャタピー　なんか = 'a thing like Caterpie'.

patterns.name: 〜じゃだめ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is casual for では. じゃ　ダメ means 'not OK if it's'. キャタピー　なんか　じゃ　ダメか = 'so Caterpie won't do?'
